thread.title: Apple, Inc. ( AAPL ) RECOMMENDATION: BUY | TARGET PRICE: $19

author: Nick Clayton
title: Apple, Inc. ( AAPL ) RECOMMENDATION: BUY | TARGET PRICE: $19
text:
Apple, Inc. ( AAPL ) RECOMMENDATION: BUY | TARGET PRICE: $195 | CURRENT PRICE: $172.89 (Feb.22, 2018) Apple Inc. has always been an industry leading brand with a track record of solid financial performance (see Table 1 below). The company has been growing rapidly at a 5-year compounded annual growth rate (CAGR) of 8% in sales and it still has strong drivers of long-lasting growth in the future. Currently, the stock is trading in the $170s (52-week change of about +27%) and the impressive thing is that the stock still looks like an attractive growth opportunity with strong upside potential. According to my discounted cash flow model, Apple stock's target price is $195 (+12% versus current price). Thus, I currently have a BUY rating on AAPL stock with the following Key Investment Rationale: 
Growing Smartphone demand. AAPL will continue to benefit from robust Smartphone demand across the globe. According to IDC, the worldwide Smartphone market (units shipped) will grow at a CAGR of 3.3% through 2021. The average selling price of the Smartphones is also expected to increase. Apple's average selling prices held up nicely over the holidays - hitting $796, compared to the $755.78 price point that was expected. These factors ensure strong top-line growth for AAPL. In Q1, Apple sold 77.3 million iPhone's (~16% increase compared to Q12017), which was less than the 80 million Wall Street was expecting but was offset by the increase in revenue per iPhone sold. Strong brand power. AAPL has various products (iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, iPod, etc.) in its portfolio and holds a leading market position in almost all of these in the industry. Its "iPhone" is a well-recognized product globally and accounts for more than 60% of the company's sales. Any new series or upgrades increase the sales substantially. Innovative products. AAPL has always known for its innovation strategy - the company launches upgraded versions of iPhones and new products like smart watches, smart speakers, etc. regularly. The company continues to focus on its research and development strategy, which in turns ensures sound prospects for the company. Huge cash balance. AAPL has a huge cash balance of $285.1 billion (cash and investments on its balance sheet). Though 94% of this cash has been residing outside the U.S., Apple recently announced that it's bringing its cash home (with new tax legislation lowering the repatriation tax rate to 15.5%) - which can be used in multiple ways to grow the company and unlock value for Apple shareholders . Customer concentration. AAPL's customers are primarily in the consumer, small and mid-sized business, education, enterprise and government markets. Also, no single customer accounts for more than 10% of sales - thus loss of any large customers does not pose a threat due to diverse customer concentration .
